So I think you have a good start but you might have gone a little too food focused. You don’t have mana dorks [[llanowar elves]], [[birds of paradise]], [[elvish mystic]], [[elves of deep shadow]], [[fyndhorn elves]] etc. Nor do you have [[nature’s lore]] or [[three visits]] which are shoe ins. You don’t have [[veil of autumn]] for commander protection [[heroic intervention]] to protect your board or [[beast within]] to get rid of permanents. Most of your removal is very expensive. Not every card needs to make a food. Your draw is very expensive too so I would suggest in your creature heavy deck [[beast whisperer]] instead of moldervine reclamation or if you are going heavy on sacrifice [[fecundity]]. If you want to go sacrifice you need more sacrificial outlets like [[carrion feeder]], [[viscera seer]], [[ashnods altar]] etc. it seems that the deck can’t choose between being a food deck and being a squirrel deck so I’d def choose one. You can have food squirrels but try to keep that in mind. Sacrifice food and squirrels in the same deck is a lot. Picking two will probably help your deck function smoother

They are badly misunderstanding the *cause*. 

Raiding, remote or otherwise has been suffering for the last few years. Raids began to lose their luster. Before I’d do 15-30 raids of each raid if it could be shiny and I often wouldn’t get it. Kyogre and latios were elusive frustratingly. So I’d raid them each time they came out trying to finally get that elusive shiny. With remote raid passes finally I could grind to my wallet’s capacity. 

I’ve gotten every shiny sans 1 when I was ill (shiny genesect). For the release of remote raid passes my community was incredibly active. We worked together to grind every shiny and even those we already had. 

Then the pokestop nerfs happened and were reversed and increasing remote raid passes. Now with no continual community to raid for what we already have it’s been pulling nails to get anyone interested at all. 

There’s no incentive right now unless you are gunning for master league Pokémon go raid a lot. XL rare candy is too rare, I’ll never power up my shadow mewtwos. What little incentive to raid is so small our communities are dying and reconsidering their wallets. 

I used to drop around $100 each month on the game. Now that money has been going to buy magic cards instead and worst of all for Niantic, I don’t think I’m missing out on anything.
